CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content is asserted in the text.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate sets) is identified and paired with explicit origin/representation metadata showing organization/access status for the same referents.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation condition or processing change to the identified contents' organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly enumerate represented content (color-labeled coordinate sets) with referents and times.

D.rationale: The report separates content identification (coordinate sets) from representation/origin metadata for the same referents.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The text states how contents are represented/organized (origin metadata, and a note about current vs candidate peaks).
